# PAO-CCSD-DF equations
*Generated by SeQuant from CC{2}.t() with CSV=Yes, density_fit(g→g·g·Κ), csv_transform({f,g,s}), single_term_opt(subnet_cse=true), renumber_dummies.*

## Notation

| Symbol | Meaning |
|--------|---------|
| `i, j, k, l, m, n` (labeled `i_1, i_2, …`) | Occupied molecular-orbital (MO) indices |
| `a, b, c, …` (labeled `a_1, a_2, …`) | Pair-specific virtual (PNO) indices. The subscripts in angle brackets, e.g. `a_1<i_1,i_2>`, denote the pair (or triple / quadruple) the PNO belongs to. |
| `μ̃` (labeled `μ̃_1, μ̃_2, …`) | Projected Atomic Orbital (PAO) index — the local, non-orthogonal basis into which PNOs are expanded. |
| `Κ` (labeled `Κ_1, Κ_2, …`) | Density-Fitting (DF) auxiliary-basis index, appearing as the 3rd slot of factorized two-electron integrals `g{·;·;Κ_n}`. |
| `f{p;q}` | Fock matrix element |
| `g{p;q;Κ_n}` | Three-center two-electron integral (DF factor) |
| `s{μ̃_m;μ̃_n}` | PAO-PAO overlap (non-orthogonality of the PAO basis) |
| `C{p;q}` | PAO ↔ PNO (or occupied ↔ PAO) transformation coefficient |
| `t{…;…}` | Cluster amplitude (T1, T2, T3, T4), kept in CSV/PNO form; **not** expanded into PAO |
| `Ŝ{i_1,…;a_1<…>,…}` | Biorthogonal particle-symmetrizer / projector at the head of each residual term — sits in front of R_k = ⟨P_k|H̄|0⟩. Not a tensor to be contracted numerically; it marks symmetrization of external indices. |

### Tensor-annotation convention
Every tensor prints as `label{bra;ket[;aux]}:<symmetry>`. Symmetry markers
are `N` (nonsymm), `C` (conjugate braket) and `S` (particle-symm); `:N` is
shorthand for `:N-C-S` which is the default.

### Pipeline
1. `mbpt::CC{n}.t()` with `CSV=Yes` → spin-orbital residuals with pair-specific virtuals.
2. Closed-shell spin-tracing:
   - Energy (k=0): `closed_shell_spintrace`
   - Residuals (k≥1): `closed_shell_CC_spintrace`
       • CCSD (rank≤2): **V1** biorthogonal (literal form, matches reference JSON).
       • CCSDT, CCSDTQ (rank≥3): **V2** NNS-projected (V1 is intractable — V2
         gives CCSDTQ T4 = 149 terms vs V1 T4 = 2150).
3. Per-term PAO+DF expansion:
   `density_fit(g → g·g·Κ)` → `csv_transform({f,g,s} → μ̃ with C)` →
   `flatten` → `single_term_opt(subnet_cse=true, cap n ≤ 12)` →
   `renumber_dummies({μ̃, Κ})`.
   Index extents for the cost model: `occ=10, PNO=5, PAO=200, DF-aux=500`.

# ========================================
# ENERGY EQUATION  E = ⟨0|H̄|0⟩  (closed-shell spin-traced)
# ========================================

## E — coupled-cluster energy

1. `-1 ((g{i_1;μ̃_1;Κ_1}:N-C-S * C{μ̃_1;a_1<i_1,i_2>}:N-C-S) * (g{i_2;μ̃_2;Κ_1}:N-C-S * C{μ̃_2;a_2<i_1,i_2>}:N-C-S)) * t{a_1<i_1,i_2>,a_2<i_1,i_2>;i_2,i_1}:N-C-S`

2. `2 ((g{i_1;μ̃_1;Κ_1}:N-C-S * C{μ̃_1;a_1<i_1,i_2>}:N-C-S) * (g{i_2;μ̃_2;Κ_1}:N-C-S * C{μ̃_2;a_2<i_1,i_2>}:N-C-S)) * t{a_1<i_1,i_2>,a_2<i_1,i_2>;i_1,i_2}:N-C-S`

3. `2 (f{i_1;μ̃_1}:N-C-S * C{μ̃_1;a_1<i_1>}:N-C-S) * t{a_1<i_1>;i_1}:N-C-S`

4. `-1 (g{i_1;μ̃_1;Κ_1}:N-C-S * (C{μ̃_1;a_1<i_2>}:N-C-S * t{a_1<i_2>;i_2}:N-C-S)) * (g{i_2;μ̃_2;Κ_1}:N-C-S * (C{μ̃_2;a_2<i_1>}:N-C-S * t{a_2<i_1>;i_1}:N-C-S))`

5. `2 (g{i_1;μ̃_1;Κ_1}:N-C-S * (C{μ̃_1;a_1<i_1>}:N-C-S * t{a_1<i_1>;i_1}:N-C-S)) * (g{i_2;μ̃_2;Κ_1}:N-C-S * (C{μ̃_2;a_2<i_2>}:N-C-S * t{a_2<i_2>;i_2}:N-C-S))`

# AMPLITUDE RESIDUAL EQUATIONS

# Each term carries the projector Ŝ{i...;a...} at the front.
# ========================================

7. `-1 ((((Ŝ{i_1;a_1<i_1>}:N-C-S * C{a_1<i_1>;μ̃_1}:N-C-S) * f{i_2;i_1}:N-C-S) * s{μ̃_1;μ̃_2}:N-C-S) * C{μ̃_2;a_2<i_2>}:N-C-S) * t{a_2<i_2>;i_2}:N-C-S`

## R2 — doubles residual
